title.zh: 将塔威塔威省 Sitangkai 市镇的 Ligayan 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Sitangkai 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Ligayan National High School Extension in Sitangkai, Municipality of Sitangkai, Province of Tawi-Tawi, From the Ligayan National High School and Converting the Same Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as the Sitangkai National High School and Providing Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu của Trường Trung học Ligayan Quốc gia tại Đô thị Sitangkai, Tỉnh Tawi-Tawi khỏi Trường Trung học Ligayan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Sitangkai Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขตของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Ligayan แห่งชาติในเทศบาล Sitangkai จังหวัด Tawi-Tawi ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Ligayan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Sitangkai แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Ligayan Nasional di Kotamadya Sitangkai, Provinsi Tawi-Tawi dari Sekolah Menengah Ligayan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Sitangkai Nasional
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Ligayan Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Sitangkai, Wilayah Tawi-Tawi daripada Sekolah Menengah Ligayan Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Sitangkai Kebangsaan

text.en: The Ligayan National High School Extension in Sitangkai, Municipality of Sitangkai, Province of Tawi- Tawi is hereby separated from the Ligayan National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Sitangkai National High School.

The Department of Education, Culture and Sports - Autonomous Regional Government in Muslim Mindanao (ARMM) shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
All personnel, records, assets and liabilities of the Ligayan National High School Extension are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Sitangkai National High School.

The amount necessary for the initial implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Ligayan National High School Extension in Sitangkai under the Department of Education, Culture and Sports -Autonomous Regional Government in Muslim Mindanao (ARMM). Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the continuous operation and maintenance of the Sitangkai National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
